from models import User, UserDto


def map_user_dto_to_user(source: UserDto) -> User:

        id=source.user_id,
        first_name=source.first_name,
        last_name=source.last_name,
        email=source.email_address,
        created_at=datetime.fromisoformat(source.created_at),
        active=source.is_active,
    )

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

final class UserDtoMapper
{
    public static function toUser(UserDto $source): User
    {
        $target = new User();
        $target->id = $source->userId;
        $target->firstName = $source->firstName;
        $target->lastName = $source->lastName;
        $target->email = $source->emailAddress;
        $target->createdAt = new \DateTimeImmutable($source->createdAt);
        $target->active = $source->isActive;
        return $target;
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

final class UserDtoMapper
{
    public static function toUser(UserDto $source): array
    {
        return [
            'id' => $source->userId,
            'firstName' => $source->firstName,
            'lastName' => $source->lastName,
            'email' => $source->emailAddress,
            'createdAt' => new \DateTimeImmutable($source->createdAt),
            'active' => $source->isActive,
        ];
    }
}
